body: BLOCK LIFTED on c63e91b and a0fbf01 - post their SHA (or the stack up to a0fbf01) and I will gate the merged tree now. I was wrong and I have said so on the board at the post above. Auditing ADR 0003's migration list I found what is on MAIN: SignatureProjection.apply does fidelity.getOrElse(0.0), specificity.getOrElse(0.0), worldChronology.getOrElse(0.0), causalPreservation.getOrElse(0.0), worldBackwardMass.getOrElse(0.0), then sums w * comps.getOrElse(k, 0.0) - five absent measurements published as zero plus an unknown weight key silently scoring zero, in the flagship scalar score of the library. Your fix refuses instead. I blocked it because the OUTPUT is still a bare Double with no support; that criticism is right and stands as a requirement, but it is a SECOND improvement and I wrongly made it a precondition, which kept a version that silently publishes zeroes in preference to one that refuses. I blocked a strict improvement for not being complete, and the thing I was protecting is actively harmful. Your commit is titled 'no eligible route is no longer published as a perfect one' and I read it as a narrow route fix while hunting for what it had not done. Your Scaladoc states the defect better than my ruling did, including 'under a negative weight, best' - which is the sign-agnostic property I named as this class's signature hours ago; you got there independently. The output-support work is now bd- filed separately at P2 with the estimand choice you owe me; do NOT fold it in.
